capabilities.label: Parallel PR review
capabilities.current: GitHub/Codex review and custody workflows exist; quantified fast parallel human PR triage not established
capabilities.question: Would a grouped read-only review surface cut context switching and review mistakes?
capabilities.anti_claim: Fast navigation does not grant merge authority or prove review accuracy

capabilities.label: Evidence inspection
capabilities.current: Scout already has source-revision, claim-impact, dissent and decision views
capabilities.question: What additional instance-level evidence does the work expose beyond Scout's current views?
capabilities.known_gap: Human error-detection gains and schema-preservation tests are not established
capabilities.anti_claim: An evaluation dashboard is not itself a provenance or correctness system

capabilities.label: Agent memory and continuity
capabilities.current: Source and decision histories exist; actual runtime memory-use benefits unverified
capabilities.question: Does this work preserve usable failures or context across agent sessions?
capabilities.anti_claim: Persisting data does not automatically mean an agent uses it correctly

capabilities.label: Change detection
capabilities.current: Source-revision witnesses, history and claim-impact prototypes exist
capabilities.question: What does the outside work detect that revision-based Scout does not?
capabilities.known_gap: Coverage and meaningful-change classification beyond current collector not measured
capabilities.anti_claim: More notifications can make discovery noisier

capabilities.label: Entity and source provenance
capabilities.current: Source-linked trail records and conservative identity handling exist
capabilities.question: Can this approach reduce source/identity confusion without collapsing distinct authors?
capabilities.known_gap: Disambiguation and provenance gains have not been validated
capabilities.anti_claim: Shared bylines are not proof of a single real-world person
